---
title: Cursor location in px
subtitle: Change cursor location in µm to in pixel (px)
date: 2026-07-28
toc-depth: 4
toc-expand: true
lang: en 
---

QuPath默认cursor location的坐标基准是µm（见下图右下角）。

![Cursor location in µm.](images/2026-07-28_cursor-location-px.png){fig-align="center" width="100%"}

在`Edit` &rarr; `Preferences`，不要勾选`Use calibrated location text`。

![Cursor location in px.](images/2026-07-28_cursor-location-px-1.png)

另外，`Location text font size`可用于控制cursor location text的大小。本示例的`Location text font size`是`Huge`。

![Location text font size.](images/2026-07-28_cursor-location-px-2.png)
